visual.hint: Where do the two counts first land on the same number?

problems.explain: Counting in 98s and counting in 84s, the first number both reach is 588. That is the lowest common multiple. Or use the GCF: 98 × 84 ÷ 14 = 588.

prompt.v: What is the lowest common multiple of 99 and 110?

rules: each prime, as many times as either one has it
visual.hint: Counting up would take a while. What are they made of?

problems.explain: 99 is 3² × 11 and 110 is 2 × 5 × 11. A multiple of both needs every prime either one has, as many times as it has it: 2 × 3² × 5 × 11 = 990. Or use the GCF: 99 × 110 ÷ 11 = 990.
